SINGLE_HYPOTHESIS: In ProcessWideFp32CachedRows pass 2, release the gamma staging slot after the Mul and the bias staging slot after the Add, and prefetch the next tile's gamma/bias into the freed slots so the MTE2 loads overlap the current tile's Add and Store. Same UB footprint. The affine expression order (y * invRms) * gamma + bias is unchanged. This is the pass-2 analog of H4/V025's pass-1 residual staging liveness.
WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: V025/H4 was pass-1 residual staging release (different pass, different buffer). V020 was a pass-1 dual-slot prefetch that ADDED a second staging pair plus four event IDs and correctness-failed 507035; V026 adds no pair and is pass-2. V021 moved the pass-2 SyncMTE3ToV (store-drain wait); V026 does not touch the store drain, only the parameter staging lifetime. R31B H1 (store drain deferral) and STORE-EPILOGUE-X H1 (blocked writeback) are untouched. EPILOGUE-ARITH (Mul/Add fusion) untouched: Mul and Add remain separate with their barriers. SHAPE-TILING (tile constants) untouched. Full analysis in 研究/R31A/next-hypotheses-v2.md H5 section.

CONSTRAINTS.parent_module_rebuild: REQUIRED: the paired harness parent module must be rebuilt from V025 (14751167...) so the OFAT comparison is V025 vs V026. Both module SHAs go in the record.
CONSTRAINTS.same_UB_footprint: honored; no new buffer pair (D=32768 free UB is about 4 KB, a second gamma/bias pair needs 61440 B)
CONSTRAINTS.correctness_priority: same risk class as H4/V025 (staging-liveness sync split); H4 passed 4 correctness runs, use that as the proven pattern.

MECHANISM_DETAIL.per_tile: Load(gamma,bias) unless prefetched → SyncMTE2ToV → Mul(value,gamma) → PipeBarrier → SyncVToMTE2 + prefetch next gamma into xBuf_ → Add(value,bias) → PipeBarrier → SyncVToMTE2 + prefetch next bias into residualBuf_ → SyncVToMTE3 → Store → SyncMTE3ToV
MECHANISM_DETAIL.overlap: next tile's gamma MTE2 overlaps the current tile's Add and Store; next tile's bias MTE2 overlaps the current tile's Store
MECHANISM_DETAIL.prefetch_handoff: paramsPrefetched flag carries across iterations so a tile that received prefetched gamma/bias skips its own loads; the top SyncMTE2ToV still waits for the prefetched loads
MECHANISM_DETAIL.blanket_sync_note: each SyncVToMTE2 releases both staging slots, but only the intended slot is written by the prefetch; the other slot keeps its live data (gamma read by Mul, bias read by Add) exactly as the H4/V025 pass-1 pattern does.

PRECISION_RISK: None. Same Mul and Add on the same values in the same order; only the staging lifetime and load timing change.
